core_obligations: First proof: combine the presheaf description of higher direct images with the compatibility of cohomology with restriction to an open to read off the displayed equality (proof lines 645-646).

Second proof: choose an injective resolution of F and observe that its restriction to the inverse image of V is an injective resolution of the restriction of F, so that it computes the higher direct images of g (proof lines 647-650).
Note that the same resolution argument covers the derived image of a bounded below complex, as asserted at the end of the statement (proof lines 639-641).
proof_roadmap: First proof by the presheaf description (proof lines 645-646).
Second proof by restriction of an injective resolution (proof lines 647-650).
difficulty_reason: For a morphism of ringed spaces, a module F and an open subspace V of the target, with g the restriction of f over the inverse image of V, the lemma shows that the higher direct images of the restriction agree with the restrictions of the higher direct images, and that the same holds for the derived image of a bounded below complex (statement lines 629-642). The author gives two proofs: the first applies the description of higher direct images as the sheaf associated to the presheaf of cohomology on inverse images together with the compatibility of cohomology with restriction to an open; the second chooses an injective resolution and uses that its restriction is again an injective resolution computing the higher direct images on the open (proof lines 644-650). The claim is H2: the second proof is a genuine two-line argument about resolutions, and the author supplies it in addition to the first.
